ddl.where: account_id is not null and status in ('active', 'disabled')
ddl.name: identity_membership_live_account_idx

ddl.where: "issues"."worktree_path" IS NOT NULL AND "issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: idx_issues_worktree

ddl.where: "issues"."worktree_path" IS NOT NULL AND "issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: idx_issues_worktree_folded

ddl.where: "messages"."from_kind" = 'operator' AND "messages"."to_kind" = 'session' AND "messages"."notice_dismissed_at" IS NULL AND "messages"."delivery_status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled')
ddl.name: idx_messages_open_chat

ddl.where: "sessions"."ref_issue_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."ref_draft" IS NULL AND "sessions"."deleted_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: idx_sessions_refless_place

ddl.where: "sessions"."ref_issue_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."ref_draft" IS NULL AND "sessions"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."issue_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: idx_sessions_refless_issue

ddl.where: "sessions"."credential_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."deleted_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: idx_sessions_credential

ddl.value:
(
  ("credential_kind" = 'bearer-hash' AND "token_hash" <> '' AND "public_key" IS NULL)
  OR ("credential_kind" = 'ed25519' AND "token_hash" = '' AND "public_key" IS NOT NULL
      AND length("public_key") = 51 AND substr("public_key", 1, 8) = 'ed25519:')
)
ddl.name: machines_credential_material

ddl.value: stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('self', 'parent', 'forced', 'exited')
ddl.name: sessions_stop_reason_check

ddl.value: created_by_actor_kind IS NULL OR created_by_actor_kind IN ('user', 'agent', 'machine', 'system')
ddl.name: sessions_created_by_actor_kind

ddl.value: (finished_at IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL) OR (finished_at IS NOT NULL AND outcome IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ship_attempts_terminal_pair_check

ddl.value: outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')
ddl.name: ship_attempts_outcome_check

ddl.value: (validation_profile_id IS NULL AND validation_result IS NULL) OR (validation_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND validation_result IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ship_attempts_validation_pair_check

ddl.value: validation_result IS NULL OR validation_result IN ('passed', 'failed')
ddl.name: ship_attempts_validation_result_check

ddl.value: (resolved_at IS NULL AND resolution IS NULL) OR (resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolution IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ship_holds_resolution_pair_check

ddl.value: (state = 'held' AND hold_code IS NOT NULL) OR (state <> 'held' AND hold_code IS NULL)
ddl.name: ship_orders_hold_code_check

ddl.value:
(state = 'planned' AND started_at IS NULL AND finished_at IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL)
          OR (state = 'running' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL)
          OR (state IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND outcome IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ship_steps_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: (released_at IS NULL AND release_reason IS NULL) OR (released_at IS NOT NULL AND release_reason IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ship_train_manifests_release_pair_check
